نلتزم (form VIII)
# نَلْتَزِمُ (naltazimu) /nal.ta.zi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# نُلْتَزَمُ (nultazamu) /nul.ta.za.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# نَلْتَزِمَ (naltazima) /nal.ta.zi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# نُلْتَزَمَ (nultazama) /nul.ta.za.ma/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
